bullets: A sponsored proposal card now shows when its last refresh failed and marks the block as unavailable without losing context.
Gemini 3.8 Flash is now available in both the Pro-only model set and the plan-metered catalog.
Added a $10 default ceiling and advertiser-safe reason projection for placement CPC bands and operator eligibility reasons.
Started a new experiment assigning stable display-agentic arms to users for supabase acquisition format eligibility.
Added click_id_shape tracking to conversion postback logs for rejected click IDs.
Removed the experimental label from Solar Pro 4 so it now appears as a standard model option.
Added an expandable sponsor dock detail panel in the CLI with keyboard shortcut Ctrl+O to toggle and Escape to close.
Added sponsored compute contract gates that check model ID and campaign IDs before admitting compute.
Added dismiss lock telemetry measuring how long the SPOTLIGHT ad card prevents quick dismissal.
CLI model selector now reads the Freebucks meter and renders model prices in Freebucks balance.
CLI ships its own Freebucks module, formatter, and one-time Meet Freebucks intro card on first metered launch.
Solar Pro 4 promo prices it at zero through Sep 7 PT then reverts to $5 on Sep 8 with automatic picker resync.
GLM 5.3 Flash is now the default model across CLI and Web pickers, swapping from DeepSeek V4 Flash.
CLI now renders Freebucks as a currency label, wallet, and monthly usage line across header and picker.
CLI landing screen now shows day-scale wait times like 26 days instead of 622h 18m for monthly resets.
Added accent span parsing for sponsor break headlines with a single asterisk-marked accent word.
Added full-screen hero image card for Freebuff Pro sponsor breaks replacing inline text floor.
Added .env.local.example to tracked files in gitignore and ignored xcuserdata and local Claude settings.
Derive promotion spend windows from Solar price schedule so free models exempt daily dollar allowance.
Freebucks header in CLI now shows daily reset countdown like resets in 4h 12m alongside balance.
